_comment: Troll (intermission triage Session ②, item 20): a solitary bruiser that squats at the map outskirts between the bandit camps and the orc front. Hostile to players only — it is a lone monster, not part of any war (bandits/orcs/wildlife ignore it and it ignores them). Drops Tough, repairing the Barrier recipe. [PLACEHOLDER]
